name: @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent
integration: Unmodified native Pi SDK agent loop, default four native tool definitions and prompts. Tool operation callbacks delegate to Harbor over JSON-lines RPC. No task filesystem is mounted into the inference container.
training_harness_version: The upstream RL adapter model card does not pin a Pi version. This integration pins published Pi1.5.2 explicitly; exact training-version equivalence is not claimed.
